name: REJAL
tagline: Heritage superfoods · Kesihatan itu satu pelaburan

definition.summary: REJAL™ is SuamiSihat's heritage food brand: wild Tualang honey, single-clove garlic (bawang lanang) steeped in Tualang honey, and a stevia sweetener, presented with Malay heritage and restraint. Sold as food, never as medicine.

definition.claimsReview: Never publish: 'melancarkan darah', 'tenaga batin', immunity, cardiovascular, digestive or nitric-oxide benefits, 'organic', lab values (TPC, diastase, SAC %). Describe ingredients, origin and use only. Every label needs kcal/kJ nutrition, a real serving size, net weight, the infant warning on honey, and Halal/MeSTI only from that manufacturer's own valid certificate.

positioning.statement: Warisan Melayu, untuk lelaki yang melabur dalam kesihatan. REJAL brings wild Tualang honey and honey-steeped bawang lanang from Malaysian forests to the modern table, with dignity and without hype.

pillars.title: Malay heritage
pillars.text: The tengkolok stands for dignity and tradition. Recipes and ingredients Malaysians already know.

pillars.title: Honest sourcing
pillars.text: Say where it comes from and what is in the jar. Origin and ingredients are the story, not promises.

pillars.title: Quietly premium
pillars.text: Matte black, one blue emblem, gold only as a material finish. Restraint reads as quality.

voice: Dignified and warm, like a family recipe passed on
Plain-spoken: ingredients, origin, how to enjoy it
avoid: Medical or sexual-health language (ubat, melancarkan darah, tenaga batin, kuat)
Lab numbers or percentages without a report on file

No green (implies 'organic'; green belongs to Dr Mit Ring). Tokens: static/assets/tokens/product-brands.tokens.json.

pattern.name: REJAL repeat texture
pattern.description: Staggered rows of the condensed REJAL wordmark in dark grey (#3A3536) on Rejal Black, as used on the Stevia box flaps and back panels.
usage: Use on Rejal Black only: box flaps, back panels, web section backgrounds
Keep text on a solid Rejal Black panel, never directly on the texture
Never run the texture behind the main wordmark or emblem
Do not recolour the texture; it stays a quiet tone-on-tone

logos.label: REJAL wordmark (white)
logos.use: Primary: on Rejal Black and dark photography

logos.label: Emblem: tengkolok, Jawi arc and QUALITY | ORIGINAL ribbon
logos.use: Dark backgrounds only (the ring gap is transparent)

guideline.clearSpace: Keep half the height of the wordmark letters (½ X) clear on every side. No text, badges or edges inside this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Wordmark 18 mm / 72 px wide; emblem lockup 30 mm / 120 px; tengkolok alone 12 mm / 48 px (raster: do not enlarge past 30 mm until the vector version exists)
do: White wordmark on Rejal Black, black wordmark on white
Keep the centre stack order: Jawi arc, REJAL, emblem ribbon, product name, size box
Show the real product with a readable label
dont: Do not use the old 'Rijal' spelling or ® next to REJAL
Do not recolour the wordmark (never green or gold) or stretch it
Do not place the emblem on white
Do not use AI-rendered packaging or place claims next to the logo

typography.display: Bold condensed caps for the wordmark and product names (Bebas Neue as digital stand-in); Poppins Medium caps, tracked +300, for section labels
typography.body: Poppins Regular; mandatory label text at least 6 pt
typography.note: Never retype the wordmark or the Jawi tagline; always place the supplied files.

guideline.photography: Real product, warm low-key light, dark stone or aged wood, raw ingredients in shot. Cut-outs on white for marketplaces. No AI renders.
